channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Tarifas de Trump não vão funcionar e fortalecerão Lula, diz Nobel de Economia
item.description: Nobel laureate economist Paul Krugman argues that Trump's tariffs on Brazil will be economically ineffective and will instead strengthen President Lula politically. He condemns the tariffs as an unjust punishment for Brazil's success with PIX, which he calls 'the money of the future,' and for its democratic consolidation, contrasting with the U.S., where Bolsonaro was prosecuted for attempting a coup. Krugman also links the hostility toward PIX to the Trump administration's broader opposition to progress that threatens the interests of oligarchic donors.

item.title: Agenda da semana: tarifaço e largada das convenções eleitorais
item.description: The week of July 20–24, 2026 marks the start of Brazil’s electoral calendar with the opening of party conventions to define candidacies for the October elections, including Patrus Ananias’s pre-candidacy for Minas Gerais governor under the PT. At the same time, the U.S. imposes a 25% tariff on Brazilian goods, escalating trade tensions, while international events unfold: Trump meets Lebanon’s president, the Régis Bittencourt highway auction proceeds, and major corporations release Q2 earnings.

item.title: Copa do Mundo: veja, em números, a campanha da Seleção Brasileira
item.description: Brazil finished the 2026 World Cup in 11th place after losing to Norway 2-1 in the round of 16, concluding a campaign with three wins, one draw, and one loss. The team recorded the lowest possession in a defeat against a European side in World Cup history (36%), with goals scored only by Vini Jr. (4) and Matheus Cunha (3), and Neymar Jr. scoring Brazil's lone goal against Norway.

item.title: Agenda de Lula: leia os compromissos do presidente nesta 2ª feira
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva has a schedule at the Planalto Palace on Monday, July 20, 2026, including the signing of Bill No. 2.583/2020, which establishes the National Health Strategy of the Economic-Industrial Health Complex (Ensceis), and meetings with ministers and authorities to discuss administrative and public policy matters. The agenda features meetings with the Minister of the Civil House, Miriam Belchior, and other cabinet members overseeing Transport, Environment, Regional Integration, and Indigenous Peoples, as well as Pará Governor Hana Ghassan.

item.title: Prefeitura de SP pagou R$ 114 milhões a ONG de produtora de Dark Horse
item.description: The São Paulo City Hall paid R$ 114 million to the Instituto Conhecer Brasil (ICB), led by Karina Ferreira da Gama, producer of the Dark Horse film about Jair Bolsonaro, for Wi-Fi point installation and maintenance. The contract is under investigation by the Civil Police for alleged diversion of funds to finance the movie. The city claims the target of 5,000 points was reduced to 3,200, with damaged equipment being constantly relocated, denying payment for uninstalled points.

item.title: Eleições 2026: saiba o que os pré-candidatos ao Planalto farão nesta 2ª feira
item.description: On Monday, Lula (PT) sanctions the National Health Strategy of the Industrial Health Economic Complex at 11 a.m., followed by meetings with legal advisors and the Minister of the Civil House. Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) gives a videoconference interview to Rádio Correio of Paraíba. Renan Santos (Missão) attends a supporter meeting in Cuiabá, while Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) is expected to attend the joint PP and União Brasil state convention in São Paulo at 7 p.m., which will formalize Guilherme Derrite’s Senate candidacy.

item.title: PT lança Patrus Ananias como candidato ao governo de MG nesta 2ª feira
item.description: The PT has designated Patrus Ananias as its candidate for governor of Minas Gerais in the 2026 elections, ending internal uncertainty. The federal deputy and former mayor of Belo Horizonte accepted Lula’s invitation, stepping down from his re-election bid for Congress to run for state office. The move is considered strategic for Lula, given MG’s status as the country’s second-largest electoral college.

item.title: PF ativa sala de comando para proteger presidenciáveis em tempo real
item.description: The Federal Police activated the National Command and Control Center in Brasília to monitor in real time the security of presidential candidates in the 2026 elections. The center, capable of supporting up to ten candidacies and 458 personnel, will coordinate field teams, schedules, and logistics, with individualized security plans based on risk assessments and threat analysis.

item.title: Em largada das convenções, Centrão segue disposto a ficar neutro sobre corrida presidencial
item.description: The Centrão parties (União Brasil, PP, and Republicanos) will remain neutral in the 2026 presidential race, not endorsing any presidential candidate and allowing their members to freely choose alliances. This marks a shift from earlier expectations of supporting Flávio Bolsonaro, whose candidacy has been weakened by successive crises. Party conventions, mostly held in São Paulo, will confirm candidacies between July 25 and August 5, with registration by August 16 and the official campaign start on August 17.

item.title: Sob PT, comissão de fiscalização não aprova auditorias na Câmara
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies' Financial Fiscalization and Control Committee, chaired by PT-RS deputy Alexandre Lindenmeyer, failed to approve any audit or oversight proposals in 2026, leaving 124 of 186 motions stalled—mostly from the opposition. While low-impact items proceeded, requests to audit federal advertising, the Minha Casa, Minha Vida program, and the INSS crisis were ignored, as criticized by MDB-MA deputy Hildo Rocha.

item.title: Milei e Tarcísio se reunirão em SP em mais um gesto do presidente da Argentina à direita brasileira
item.description: Argentine President Javier Milei will meet with São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas on January 25, during the PL national convention that will formalize Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential candidacy. The meeting, initiated by the Argentine government, will take place at the Palácio dos Bandeirantes after Milei’s arrival on the night of the 24th. Although Tarcísio has publicly praised Milei’s economic policies as an inspiration for Brazil, he is expected to remain distant from the presidential campaign to avoid jeopardizing his own re-election bid in 2026.

item.title: Podcast: os primeiros impactos e reações ao tarifaço de Trump no comércio e na diplomacia
item.description: The Lula government is evaluating responses to Donald Trump’s 25% tariff on Brazilian products, including sovereignty defenses, expanded credit for affected firms, and export market diversification. The possible application of the Economic Reciprocity Law is also under discussion, though implementation will take time. Reactions aim to mitigate commercial and diplomatic impacts without escalating tensions.

item.title: Convenções partidárias começam nesta segunda-feira em todo o país
item.description: Party conventions for the 2026 Brazilian elections begin this Monday (July 20) and run until August 5, officially defining candidates for president, governor, senator, and federal and state deputies, as well as party alliances. During this period, pre-candidates become official candidates after being endorsed by their parties, but are still prohibited from requesting votes under electoral law. The national conventions of the PL, PSD, and PT are scheduled for July 25, July 26, and August 2, respectively, to formalize the candidacies of Flávio Bolsonaro, Ronaldo Caiado, and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.

item.title: Tarifa de Trump: Lula e Flávio travam guerra por narrativa eleitoral
item.description: The U.S. decision to impose an additional 25% tariff on Brazilian products, announced on July 15 and set to take effect on July 22, will become a central theme in the 2026 presidential campaign. Lula’s team plans to link the measure to Flávio Bolsonaro’s allies, using the term 'Tariflávio' and accusing the senator of worsening Brazil-U.S. trade relations through his activities in Washington, including meetings with Trump and participation in USTR hearings.

item.title: Flávio recusa proteção da PF e fala em risco de infiltração
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) declined federal police protection for his 2026 presidential campaign, citing concerns of infiltration by the PF and requesting that assigned agents be redirected to investigate alleged INSS fraud involving Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, son of President Lula. He expressed distrust in PF Director-General Andrei Rodrigues, accusing the agency of being used to target Lula’s political opponents.

item.title: Tarifaço de Trump traz política externa ao debate eleitoral em SP
item.description: The article discusses how tariffs imposed by the U.S. against Brazil, announced by Donald Trump, have become a central theme in Brazil’s 2026 electoral debate. National pre-candidates like Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, and state-level candidates like Tarcísio de Freitas and Fernando Haddad, are incorporating foreign policy into their campaigns, with Tarcísio having previously endorsed MAGA-aligned positions before shifting to defend São Paulo’s interests. Strategist Felipe Soutello notes that the internationalization of the electoral agenda is a novelty, particularly as Brazilian politicians must now explain their support for policies harming national industry.

item.title: Pablo Marçal não vai à convenção do União-PP enquanto aguarda decisão do TSE
item.description: Pablo Marçal, a digital influencer affiliated with União Brasil, is not expected to attend the União-PP federation convention this Monday (20) at Alesp, as he awaits a TSE decision on his candidacy. His absence comes while he awaits legal rulings that could affect his participation in the 2026 elections.

item.title: A estratégia de Flávio Bolsonaro para tentar superar turbulências às vésperas da convenção
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro was advised by his pre-campaign team to respond to accusations from allies and adversaries, intensify criticism of the Lula government, claim persecution by the STF, and focus on public security to reverse declining poll numbers, where he trails Lula 37% to 45% in a potential runoff. The strategy aims to regain support from non-Bolsonarist right-wing voters amid internal party distrust and recent controversies, including ties to Daniel Vorcaro, criticism from Michelle Bolsonaro, being barred from visiting his father, and accusations of encouraging U.S. tariffs on Brazilian goods.

item.title: Nikolas compara vitória da seleção espanhola às eleições
item.description: Deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) compared Spain's victory over Argentina in the 2026 World Cup final to the 2026 Brazilian elections, stating that 'good prevailed' and that the next victory will come in October. He implied that the right, represented by Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), is the 'good', while Lula (PT) represents 'evil' in the political landscape. Spain won 1-0 in extra time at MetLife Stadium, securing its second World Cup title.

item.title: No embate com os EUA, o que vale para Lula por ora é o ganho eleitoral
item.description: The trade clash between Brazil and the U.S., triggered by Trump's tariffs, may be politically beneficial for Lula in an election year, as it allows him to leverage an external threat to bolster domestic support. While export sectors suffer economically, the electoral gains from confronting Trump likely outweigh the negative impact on his popularity. Lula's optimal strategy, for now, is to negotiate with Washington without making major concessions, avoiding excessive retaliation under the Reciprocity Law.

item.title: Para Nikolas, "o bem venceu" na Copa: "Agora é em outubro"
item.description: Federal Deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) celebrated Spain's 2026 World Cup victory with a social media post stating 'Good prevailed. Now it's in October,' making an indirect reference to the October presidential elections that year. Although he did not name anyone, the post was interpreted as a signal of support for the Bolsonarist camp, with Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) mentioned as a potential candidate. The message was posted minutes after Spain's 1-0 extra-time win over Argentina at MetLife Stadium in New Jersey.

item.title: Lula recebeu ao menos 16 estrangeiros enquanto esteve preso
item.description: Lula received visits from at least 16 foreign officials, intellectuals, and activists during his 580-day imprisonment between 2018 and 2019, including former presidents, philosophers, and labor leaders. Some visits were blocked by the judiciary, such as those of Nobel Peace Prize winner Adolfo Pérez Esquivel and Vatican advisor Juan Grabois. In 2026, Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes denied a request for Javier Milei to visit Jair Bolsonaro under house arrest.

item.title: Flávio diz que abrirá mão de segurança da PF na campanha
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) stated he will not use Federal Police security during the 2026 election campaign, citing distrust in the agency's current leadership under Andrei Rodrigues. The comment was made in a social media post on Sunday, the 19th.

item.title: Vice deixa chapa de Douglas Ruas e desiste da disputa ao governo do RJ
item.description: Former Nova Iguaçu mayor Rogério Lisboa (PP) withdrew as the vice-gubernatorial candidate on Douglas Ruas's (PL) ticket for Rio de Janeiro governor, citing strictly personal reasons. The PP maintains support for Ruas's candidacy but is evaluating neutrality in the race, which could lead to the exit of União Brasil from the federation. The withdrawal complicates Ruas's pre-campaign and weakens Flávio Bolsonaro's political base in the state.

item.title: Janja se livra de outro processo no TCU por viagens internacionais
item.description: The TCU dismissed a case against First Lady Janja regarding alleged misuse of public funds for international travel, stating the issue had already been resolved in a prior ruling with no evidence of illegality. Janja defended her trips as official work, claiming criticism stems from misogyny, and emphasized her use of embassies and business class for security and protocol reasons.

item.title: Vice deixa chapa do PL no Rio e impõe novo baque à direita; federação PP-União tende a ficar neutra na eleição
item.description: Rogério Lisboa (PP) withdrew as the PL's vice-presidential candidate for Rio de Janeiro governor, paving the way for the PP-União federation's likely neutrality. This isolates the PL led by Douglas Ruas and Flávio Bolsonaro, while benefiting Eduardo Paes (PSD), who has secured backing from MDB, PT, PDT and others. The PL's state convention is scheduled for March 24.

item.title: Michelle Bolsonaro descarta ser vice de Zema: ‘não há nenhuma possibilidade’
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro ruled out the possibility of being Romeu Zema's running mate in the 2026 presidential race, stating there is 'no possibility' due to her PL affiliation and her focus on caring for her husband, Jair Bolsonaro, who is under house arrest. She also clarified that she has not yet decided whether to run for Senate in the Federal District, dismissing any speculation about joining Zema's ticket.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro lança candidatura à Presidência, e Lula lança Haddad em SP
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro announced his presidential candidacy, while Lula announced Fernando Haddad as the gubernatorial candidate for São Paulo. The week begins with party conventions to select candidates for the October elections, with a deadline of August 5 for officialization.

item.title: Saúde de Jair Bolsonaro é principal divisor de águas na guerra entre Michelle e Flávio
item.description: The declining health of Jair Bolsonaro has become the central point of contention between his son Flávio Bolsonaro and his ex-wife Michelle Bolsonaro, with allies accusing Flávio of endangering Jair’s house arrest by releasing a public letter. Bolsonarist lawmakers defend Michelle, claiming she prioritizes Jair’s health, while Flávio faces criticism for actions seen as damaging to family unity. Valdemar Costa Neto stated Flávio will lose the election unless he wins Michelle’s backing, and is attempting to mediate a reconciliation within the PL.

item.title: Questionado sobre apoio a presidenciáveis, ACM Neto diz respeitar aliados e que estará com Ronaldo Caiado: 'É a minha posição'
item.description: ACM Neto, pre-candidate for governor of Bahia from União Brasil, declared his support for Ronaldo Caiado for president, citing friendship and political partnership. He stated he respects allies who support Flávio Bolsonaro but affirmed his position is defined, though not yet formalized by his staff. His convention to officially launch his Bahia gubernatorial candidacy will be held next Wednesday (22).

item.title: Lula lamenta morte de Matheus Azevedo, irmão caçula de Cleitinho
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva lamented the death of Matheus Augusto Azevedo, younger brother of Senator Cleitinho Azevedo, who passed away after battling leukemia. Lula expressed solidarity with the family in a social media post, extending his condolences to brothers Cleitinho, Eduardo, and Gleidson Azevedo, as well as all relatives and friends. The City of Divinópolis declared three days of official mourning due to the loss.

item.title: Como funcionam as convenções partidárias que começam nesta segunda-feira
item.description: Party conventions for the 2026 elections begin on July 20, with a final deadline of August 5 to select candidates for president, governor, senator, federal, state, and district deputies. Parties must choose the format (in-person, online, or hybrid), draft an attendance record and candidate list, and submit them to the TSE by August 16. Some parties, like Flávio Bolsonaro’s PL, still have open slots, particularly for vice-president, with Senator Tereza Cristina (PP-MS) being considered as a potential running mate.

item.title: Esposa de Moraes recebeu R$ 129 milhões “para fingir que está advogando”, diz Flávio
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) accused Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes of using his wife, Viviane Barci, to receive R$129 million in administrative legal contracts, claiming she was merely 'pretending' to be a lawyer. The statement was made during a PL event in Vitória on Saturday, the 18th, as part of broader criticism of alleged influence peddling. Flávio Bolsonaro is a pre-candidate for president in the 2026 Brazilian election.

item.title: PF segue trilha de desvios do orçamento secreto que pode atingir em cheio o centrão
item.description: The Federal Police is investigating the National Department of Works against Drought (DNOCS) for embezzlement of funds from the secret budget, focusing on schemes involving federal deputies and senators from the Centrão. Authorized by STF Minister Flávio Dino, the probe reveals the agency—historically controlled by Bolsonaro allies and preserved under Lula—has been used as a patronage network and conduit for millions in misappropriated funds, including money reaching criminal factions in Ceará and politicians in Bahia. The move is seen as a political warning to Congressional leaders threatening rebellion against efforts to restrict the secret budget.

item.title: Lula x Flávio: saiba como está a corrida presidencial segundo as pesquisas de julho
item.description: July polls show President Lula leading the 2026 presidential race against Senator Flávio Bolsonaro in all scenarios, both in the first and second rounds. Despite variations in margins across institutes, Lula maintains a consistent lead, with the most recent polls showing a lead of 3 to 12 percentage points in the first round and 3 to 7 points in the second round.

item.title: Marina Silva rebate Ricardo Salles: “Tartaruga é um elogio”
item.description: Marina Silva (Rede) countered criticism from Ricardo Salles (Novo-SP) during a PSOL event in São Paulo, stating that being called a 'turtle' is a compliment, symbolizing resistance and longevity in the environmental struggle. She emphasized that Salles’s attacks were not only directed at her but also at Simone Tebet and Lula’s mother, Dona Lindu.

item.title: Lula lamenta morte de Matheus Azevedo, irmão do senador Cleitinho: 'Consternação'
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva mourned the death of Matheus Augusto Azevedo, brother of Senator Cleitinho, aged 30, due to leukemia complications. Lula expressed consternation and offered solidarity to the family, including Senator Cleitinho, state deputy Eduardo Azevedo, and former mayor Gleidson Azevedo.

item.title: União-PP de SP declarará apoio a Flávio em convenção que oficializa Derrite ao Senado
item.description: The São Paulo chapter of the União-PP federation announced it will officially endorse Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) as its presidential candidate in the state, despite national leadership still considering neutrality in the 2026 elections. The decision will be formalized at a party convention that also confirms Derrite as the Senate nominee.

item.title: Flávio compara preços entre governos Bolsonaro e Lula: poder de compra acabou
item.description: Presidential pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) released a video criticizing the high cost of living under President Lula, stating he spent R$ 908.40 on a supermarket haul in Barra da Tijuca, of which R$ 217.20 was attributed to taxes, and compared prices to those in 2019 under his father Jair Bolsonaro’s government, claiming 'the purchasing power of Brazilians has ended'. He listed items such as picanha, Nutella, Ipanema sandals, and detergent, noting the purchase would not last long for a family of 3 to 4 people.

item.title: Yamal relembra infância antes da final: "Por você e pela rua"
item.description: Lamine Yamal, 19-year-old Spanish forward, shared a childhood photo with the caption 'for you and for the street' hours before the 2026 World Cup final against Argentina. Considered one of the tournament's top stars, Yamal will face Lionel Messi, with whom he was photographed in 2007 as a baby. The final will take place at 4:00 p.m. Brasília time at MetLife Stadium in New York.

item.title: Governo Lula se apagou por medo de Mendonça
item.description: The federal government proactively removed all official records on July 4 that could be interpreted as electoral propaganda, a measure coordinated by Secom and the AGU. The action was driven by fear of sanctions from Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça, known for his strict stance against misuse of public resources in political campaigns.

item.title: Michelle Bolsonaro diz que não há ‘nenhuma possibilidade’ de ser vice de Romeu Zema
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro afirmou que não há 'nenhuma possibilidade' de ser vice de Romeu Zema, já que é filiada ao PL e o partido não pode ter dois candidatos em coligações distintas para o mesmo cargo. Ela destacou que sua prioridade é cuidar da saúde do ex-presidente Jair Bolsonaro, em prisão domiciliar, e que ainda não decidiu se será candidata ao Senado pelo DF. As declarações ocorrem após Zema sugerir Michelle como possível vice em sua chapa presidencial.

item.title: ‘Governo deve se recusar a executar certas emendas parlamentares’, diz aliado de Lula
item.description: Lula’s ally, Senator Renan Calheiros, criticized the lack of oversight in parliamentary amendments, stating the government is not obligated to execute amendments that violate technical criteria. He noted that although Lula promised in 2022 to curb irresponsible use of amendments, nothing was done due to weak political power in Congress. Experts warn that the current system, lacking technical guidelines, fragments investments and undermines structured public policies such as SUS, basic sanitation, and education.

item.title: Michelle Bolsonaro descarta ser vice de Zema: "não há nenhuma possibilidade de isso acontecer"
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro ruled out the possibility of being the vice-presidential candidate on Romeu Zema's (Novo) ticket for the 2026 elections, stating there is 'no possibility' of that happening. She explained that the PL party already has a defined candidate — her stepson, Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) — and therefore cannot have two names in the presidential race.

item.title: Ciro Gomes diz que votaria em Caiado e cita Renan Santos
item.description: Ciro Gomes, pre-candidate for governor of Ceará from the PSDB, stated that his party has not yet decided on its support for the 2026 presidential election following Aécio Neves' withdrawal. He said he would vote for Ronaldo Caiado and mentioned Renan Santos as a relevant political figure in the discussion.

item.title: Eleições: prazo para convenções partidárias começa nesta segunda-feira
item.description: The deadline for political parties to hold their conventions for the 2026 Brazilian elections begins this Monday (20) and runs until August 5, when parties must define and register their candidates for president, governor, senator, federal and state/district deputies through the TSE’s CANDex system. Conventions also formalize coalitions and draw ballot numbers, with parties retaining the right to keep numbers used in the previous election. Parties such as PDT, PL, PSD, MDB, Novo, PCdoB, PSTU, PV, Missão, PCO, PSB, and PT have already scheduled their national conventions between July 20 and August 2.

item.title: Eleitores poderão solicitar voto em trânsito a partir de 20/7
item.description: Voters who will be outside their voting municipality in the 2026 elections can apply for transit voting between July 20 and August 20. Applications can be submitted online via the TSE website or in person at electoral offices. Transit voting will allow voting for various offices depending on the state where the voter is located on election day.

item.title: Michelle fecha porta para Zema e mantém suspense sobre candidatura ao Senado
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro ruled out any possibility of being Romeu Zema’s running mate in the 2026 presidential race, stating she has not yet decided on her Senate candidacy in the Federal District. She emphasized that the PL already has Flávio Bolsonaro in the presidential race and that a party cannot field two names on different tickets, to avoid internal conflict. The former first lady also noted her departure from PL Mulher and public criticism of Flávio complicate party alliances.

item.title: Como as restrições impostas por Moraes a Bolsonaro atingem Michelle
item.description: Former first lady Michelle Bolsonaro said she faces hardships and embarrassment due to restrictions imposed by Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes on former President Jair Bolsonaro, including being barred from receiving in-home physiotherapy during authorized hours. She said she is overwhelmed, managing her husband’s health, household duties, and political affairs without external help. Michelle plans to run for a Senate seat in the Federal District and has stepped down from leading PL Mulher after a public dispute with her stepson, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Antonelli vence na Bélgica, e Bortoleto pontua após melhor classificação da Audi
item.description: Kimi Antonelli won the Belgian Grand Prix in Formula 1 for Mercedes, while Brazilian Gabriel Bortoleto finished eighth, securing Audi's best-ever classification in the category and four championship points. The podium was completed by Charles Leclerc (Ferrari) and Max Verstappen (Red Bull), with Lewis Hamilton fourth after overcoming a penalty. The race featured first-lap incidents, bold strategies, and retirements by Russell, Pérez and Stroll.
